children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may fall toward $6.13-1/4 per bushel, as it has broken a support at $6.47-3/4.
The next support will be at $6.13-1/4, the 76.4% retracement of the uptrend from $5.57-1/4 to $7.94-1/2. A rising trendline points at $6.13-1/4 as well.
A rise from the current level will be classified as a pullback toward $6.47-3/4, now a resistance. The pullback may be limited to this level.
On the hourly chart, a projection analysis on the downtrend from $6.91-1/2 suggests a realistic target of $6.31-1/4, the 261.8% level.
Immediate resistance is at $6.40-1/4, a break above which may lead to a gain into $6.42-1/4 to $6.45-1/2 range.
